Storefront and customer routes of the storefront module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/storefront/config

Get the public store identity, currency, locales, stock threshold and pixels

Responses:

- `200`: Storefront config retrieved.

## GET /v1/storefront/home-banners

DEPRECATED: Get homepage hero + mid-banner config

Deprecated. Use GET /v1/storefront/sections/:pageSlug instead. Every field is null and the route is removed in a later release.

Responses:

- `200`: Banner config retrieved (every field null on a current store).

## GET /v1/storefront/sections/{pageSlug}

Get visible storefront sections for a page (Translatable resolved, asset URLs hydrated)

Parameters:

- `pageSlug` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Sections retrieved.
- `400`: Invalid pageSlug.
